commit.message:
fix(ci): auto-merge puts a pull request back in the queue on a new head

The queue only enqueued when auto-merge was turned on, so a pull request
pushed to, or removed by a failed batch and then fixed, stayed out while
auto-merge stayed on. Now auto-merge also asks for the queue on a new
head, out of draft and on reopen; one removed at the same head stays out.

Docs: drop the unbuilt pl ci merge from the queue description, and the
publishing policy lands PRs with auto-merge, as ovea-workstyle says.
